verdict.rationale: Mastra is itself an official TypeScript SDK/framework distributed as npm packages: developers import APIs such as `createTool` from `@mastra/core/tools` and `createWorkflow`, and the packages ship embedded docs in `dist/docs` that AI agents can read. Community users report building with it hands-on for weeks or months. Missing for 10: no evidenced SDKs for languages other than TypeScript, no documented client SDK for calling a deployed Mastra server, and no published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404).
